race.comment: CALEDONIAN SUMMER (1) made really good improvement from first to second run from a spell. He sat much closer in the run and got over the top of them. That added 320m can only benefit you would think. I'MFALLINFORYOU (11) dropped back in journey to score at Moe. This is likely harder. EPEIRIC (9) was much better second-up when doing his best work late to finish midfield at Sale. Fitter again and should appreciate stretching further. DEVINE GRUNT (8) has been thereabouts without looking like winning his races.
